results.title: NJPW The New Beginning USA 2026
results.overview: The New Beginning USA 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 27, 2026, at the Cure Insurance Arena in Trenton, New Jersey, USA, and was headlined by Yota Tsuji (c) vs. Andrade El Idolo for the IWGP Global Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: The Wolf and the Lamb
results.overview: A widowed teacher in a 1870s Montana mining camp searches for her missing son, but when he returns, he has been monstrously changed by unknown forces.

results.title: Too Soon
results.overview: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

results.title: Về Quê Có Gì Vui 2
results.overview: A Tet movie by Duy Khánh.

results.title: Assi
results.overview: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

results.title: The Absence
results.overview: The principal and teachers at an elementary school receive devastating news: the mother of Bianca, a 9-year-old student, has suffered a serious accident while on her way to pick her up. Faced with the difficulty of locating other family members, they decide to create together a support and protection space for the girl.

results.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
results.original_title: प्रहार: दी अनटोल्ड स्टोरी ऑफ़ उज्ज्वल निकम
results.overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

results.title: The Copycat Killer
results.overview: A traumatized criminal profiler is lured in to investigate a copycat killer mimicking her most infamous case while being framed as the prime suspect, or risk losing her freedom and becoming the next victim of a twisted game of revenge.

results.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
results.overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

results.title: Moonzy: The Dark Side of the Moon
results.overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

results.title: Sour Minnows
results.overview: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

results.title: Parasakthi
results.overview: In a time of civil disobedience in the erstwhile Madras state, a ruthless intelligent officer turns up with a duty to track down rebels. Chezhian and his brother Chinndurai are of different personalities, one a hardworking fireman, the other a rebel. A deadly game of cat and mouse ensues as Chezhian is forced to abandon his peaceful ways to protect his people and takes on the mighty forces, culminating in a fierce battle for justice.

results.title: Amoeba
results.overview: In a repressive city-state, a tomboy schoolgirl persuades three classmates at an all-girls school to rebel by forming a triad gang.

results.title: Holy Crowd
results.overview: After Ratna rises from the dead during her funeral, her silent body begins performing unexplained healings, turning her husband Arif into the reluctant center of a growing frenzy. As villagers, opportunists, and religious authorities descend, faith and exploitation collide, and the miracle spirals beyond control.

results.title: D-76
results.overview: A lonely postal courier inherits his deceased father's camera. Immersed in the world of film photography, he begins hunting for crime stories, unaware that he himself is being hunted.

results.title: Chien Nam: The Shedding Cicada
results.original_title: Chiến Nam: Ve Sầu Thoát Xác
results.overview: When investigative journalist Ngọc disappears with evidence against the Thái Minh Legend conglomerate, a fateful USB falls into the hands of her closest friend, Kim. Marked as a target by a criminal empire, Kim’s only protector is police officer Chiến Nam. What begins as a protection mission turns into a deep infiltration. As K52—Chiến Nam’s fellow officer—goes missing and Kim is kidnapped, Chiến Nam plunges into Thái Minh’s web of conspiracies. Just when justice seems within reach, the mastermind executes a “cicada shell escape” plan. The true battle has only just begun, forcing Chiến Nam to descend into the darkest depths to uncover the truth behind a perfectly staged illusion.

results.title: Misión imposible, no... lo siguiente
results.overview: A short film with which the Spanish television program El Hormiguero begins its season.

results.title: Ethel
results.overview: Ethel Berkowitz only wants to have a quiet afternoon prepping for Halloween, but when she is interrupted by her unhinged neighbor she is forced into a tense exchange which promises to push them both to their limits.

results.title: Hollowed
results.overview: When a woman visits her fiancé’s rural hometown for the first time, she gets lost at night and finds herself in an abandoned village, where she encounters a mysterious bride and unearths long-buried family secrets.
